name: Sakura-Con
blurb: The oldest and largest anime convention in the Pacific Northwest, held every spring in downtown Seattle with cosplay contests, concerts and voice-actor guests.

picks: Tartaglia in Genshin Impact, Doppio in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
IMDB top 20 all-time anime voice actor

editions.evidence: Homepage news post: 'We'll see you March 26-28, 2027!' (April 14, 2026). The Guests page's three current entries (Griffin Burns, Tony Oliver, Monica Rial) were all announced Sept 16-30, 2026, after that post.

notes: The homepage also shows earlier Guest Announcements (Studio Orange's Masako Sato/Naoya Nakayama/Yoshihiro Watanabe, and Haruki Ishiya) dated Feb-March 2026, before the 'see you in 2027' post; the Studio Orange link points to /past-guests/sakura-con-2026/, so these belong to the already-finished 2026 edition and are excluded here. The Location page text still reads 'Sakura-Con 2026 takes place at the Seattle Convention Center' (not yet updated for 2027 wording) but confirms the convention's long-standing venue across the Arch and Summit buildings; no venue change has been announced for 2027. Verify-03 pass (2026-10-05): confirmed current -- a fresh re-extraction shows the same three guests (Griffin Burns, Monica Rial, Tony Oliver) and a separate 'Past Guests' link confirming the site keeps prior-year lineups apart from this live Guests page. Refute pass (2026-10-05): fresh re-extraction (-v2) is unchanged (same 3 guests); their headshots are uploaded to wp-content/uploads/2026/08/ (months after the March 2026 edition ended) and the page's own top banner image is named 'SakWebsiteBannerWordpress2027-2.jpg'; upheld, not stale.
